---
name: Job card
about: One small, checkable job for a coding worker. The form every queued issue should take.
---

<!-- A worker reads only this issue, AGENTS.md and the files it names. If it cannot tell when it is finished, it will not finish. -->

**Change.** <!-- What the app or the tests should do afterwards, in one or two sentences. One job, one section of the app where possible. -->

**Check.** <!-- The one UI-level check, on synthetic data, that fails on main and passes after the change. Name the suite it belongs to. For a tests-only job, what the new check asserts. -->

**Where.** <!-- Section name from docs/CODEMAP.md and the function names, if known. -->

**Rules.** <!-- What must not change: reported numbers, saved-project format, anything outside this job. -->
